subject: Mutual Commitment Plan (initial draft) — confirm stakeholders & timelines
messages:
From: Emily Clark <emily.clark@apexhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — follow-up and next steps

Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for the discovery earlier — helpful session. A couple quick items we flagged on our side:

- Primary use case: inference for clinical summaries and triage routing (low-latency, PHI minimization).
- Compliance: we need SOC2 evidence and KMS integration details for initial review.
- Procurement: internal procurement wants a target close window and a preliminary SOW/price band.

Can you share an initial mutual plan with milestones, owners, and a few timeline options for our leadership and procurement to review? Ideally something we can circulate by Monday.

Also looping in procurement alias: procurement@apexhealth.com (for contracting questions).

Emily Clark
Head of AI Platforms
Apex Health
emily.clark@apexhealth.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Emily Clark <emily.clark@apexhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Commitment Plan (draft) — two timeline options + ask to confirm stakeholders

Emily — thanks for the clear notes. Attached is an initial draft I put together (redwood-mutual-commitment-plan-v1.pdf). High level below and two timeline options depending on procurement pace.

Summary (one-paragraph):
This mutual commitment plan (MCP) outlines the milestones, dependencies, and owner responsibilities for a Q4 pilot of Redwood Inference at Apex Health covering secure deployment in a private VPC, SOC2 evidence handoff, and a 6-week pilot for clinical triage inference. Target outcomes: validated latency SLOs, integration checklist complete, and procurement sign-off for production rollout.

Proposed milestones & owners (short):
- Kickoff & tech validation (Week 0–1) — Jonas Weber (Redwood) / Emily Clark (Apex)
- Private deployment & KMS setup (Week 2–3) — Laura Bennett (Redwood SE) / Apex infra lead (TBD)
- Eval & latency tuning (Week 4–5) — Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) / Emily Clark (Apex)
- Pilot review & procurement approval (Week 6) — Jonas Weber / Apex procurement

Two timeline options:
A) Accelerated (6 weeks): procurement and SOC2 evidence expedited — target close: mid-November 2026
B) Standard (10 weeks): normal procurement windows — target close: early December 2026

Dependencies (quick):
- Apex provide sample traffic profile + PHI handling constraints by next Tue
- Procurement to provide contract template and redlines
- KMS and VPC access for Redwood SEs for deployment

Attachments: redwood-mutual-commitment-plan-v1.pdf (initial draft) — contains a milestone-by-week table and roles matrix.

Ask: please confirm: (1) owners above, (2) preferred timeline option (A or B), and (3) any additional stakeholders we should add to the MCP before we circulate to your leadership and procurement.

I can update the draft and share a Google Drive link if you'd prefer collaborative editing.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Emily Clark <emily.clark@apexhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Commitment Plan (draft) — two timeline options + ask to confirm stakeholders

Emily / team — quick technical clarifications from my side:

- For KMS we support AWS KMS and customer-managed keys in GCP; which region/account will you provision?
- For PHI minimization, we recommend a prefix-filtered pipeline and token-level redaction during ingest; I can add a short appendix in the MCP draft describing the implementation approach.

Owners: I can take point on the VPC/KMS setup and the initial deployment. Vivek will lead performance tuning and will be primary contact during the eval window.

Emily — if you can share the infra contact (name + best email) I will add them as the Apex infra owner.

Laura Bennett
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: apex-legal-questions.xlsx (placeholder)

From: Emily Clark <emily.clark@apexhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, procurement@apexhealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Commitment Plan (draft) — two timeline options + ask to confirm stakeholders

Jonas / Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few answers / updates from our side:

- Preferred timeline: Option A (accelerated). Procurement confirmed they can prioritize a short-form PO and are happy to run redlines in parallel; they asked for a price band rather than a fully firm SOW for the pilot.
- Apex infra lead: Daniel Park <daniel.park@apexhealth.com> — please add as owner on the VPC/KMS milestone.
- SOC2 evidence: I will share our security intake doc and a list of required artifacts by EOD today.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Jonas to update MCP with Daniel as infra owner and add a short KMS appendix (Laura).
2) Jonas/I to share the Drive link for the live draft for collaborative edits.
3) Procurement to review price band and provide PO template (procurement@apexhealth.com).

Confirming we expect pilot kickoff the week of Oct 19 if the accelerated path stays on track.

Thanks — Emily

Emily Clark
Head of AI Platforms
Apex Health
emily.clark@apexhealth.com
